gloss: pertaining to a contest in which only the winner is rewarded
definitions: Of or pertaining to a contest, election, or other competition in which only the winner is rewarded and none of the losers receive anything.
Of a market in which a product or service that is only slightly better than its competitors receives a disproportionately large share of revenue.
Of a neural network model: organized so that neurons in a layer compete with each other for activation.

pl.w: taki, w jakim zwycięzca bierze wszystko
